items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: He said I was going to let Hobart have Benny Goodman-- let Benny Goodman have Hobart... He said I told Benny about Hobart but I also told him, Ernie, that you had a contract on him... he would guarantee that he'd give me at least five thousand dollars

ctx.x: bandleaders are liked. I can name you some that are hated and guys don't even like to mention the fact that they worked with them, but every one that ever worked with you, Ernie--Eli Wilinsky, the Jewish kid who worked with you.

He was very fine, and I enjoyed time with him, and the funniest thing about it, I think I told you when he first began, I had a white musician in twenty eight, and some say that Benny Goodman was the first to have a mixed band, but I had a mixed band in twenty eight--
Well, he wasn't first, if you came chronologically in front of him in twenty eight.
